shift_date: - employee_number: Employee ID (leave blank for open shifts)
- role_code: Role code from workforce_roles (e.g. STAGEHAND
- department: Audio | Lighting | Video | Stage | Rigging | Security | Catering | Production
- break_minutes: Scheduled break time in minutes
- hourly_rate: Override rate (0 = use role/employee default)
- status: scheduled | confirmed | in_progress | completed | cancelled
1. Add a row for each shift needed
2. Assign employee_number when crew is confirmed
3. Leave employee_number blank for open/unfilled shifts
4. Delete this instruction section before importing
5. Import via ATLVS > Settings > Data Import > Shifts
